about: Rijksmuseum online collection (rijksmuseum.nl): search artworks and library publications, browse facets, and look up artwork, person/topic node and publication details through the site's public JSON API.

commands.summary: Search Rijksmuseum artworks by keyword with optional sort and up to two facet filters (object type, century, maker/person, ...); 20 results per page

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text search, e.g. an artist, title or subject. May be omitted when filtering only by facet.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Recorded values: Popularity (default) and TimeAscending (old to new). The UI also offers relevance, new to old, maker A-Z/Z-A and object number A-Z/Z-A, but their wire names were not recor

params.name: facet1_id
params.description: First facet node id, from list-search-facets, search-facet-values, autocomplete or get-node. Examples: painting = 3159edbfc6b22de59dfb2522fecc2706; Rachel Ruysch = 3eaff215275e2ebd47d02cfba2044cc8.

params.name: facet1_relation
params.description: Relation type for facet1_id, e.g. HasObjectType, MadeInCentury, HasPrimaryMaker or HasMuseumLocation. Use the nodeRelationType returned with the facet.

params.name: facet2_id
params.description: Second facet node id. Example: century 1600-1700 = 7600f7d20164d7c752cf402c0b0762ad.

params.name: facet2_relation
params.description: Relation type for facet2_id, e.g. MadeInCentury.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page, 1-based, 20 items per page. Check hasMoreResults in the raw response.

commands.summary: Search Rijksmuseum library publications (books, articles) by keyword; 20 results per page

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text search for publications

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order, e.g. Popularity (default) or TimeAscending

params.name: facet1_id
params.description: Optional facet node id to filter by

params.name: facet1_relation
params.description: Relation type for facet1_id, e.g. HasObjectType

params.name: page
params.description: Result page, 1-based

commands.summary: Type-ahead suggestions for a search term: matching facet nodes (object types, places, people) and objects

params.name: query
params.description: Partial or full search term

params.name: context
params.description: Which collection to suggest from

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of suggestions per group

commands.summary: List the filter groups (Maker, Object type, Century, Place, ...) with facet ids, relation types and counts for a search query

params.name: query
params.description: Search term to compute facets for

params.name: context
params.description: Collection to search

params.name: in_museum
params.description: Only objects currently on display in the museum

params.name: has_image
params.description: Only objects that have an image

commands.summary: Search within one facet group (e.g. Object type, Maker, Place) for facet values matching text, scoped to a search query; returns facet ids and relation types for search-collection

params.name: query
params.description: Main search term the facet values are scoped to

params.name: node_type
params.description: Facet group node type, as returned by list-search-facets (nodeType), e.g. ObjectType, Artist, Place, Century

params.name: facet_query
params.description: Text to match within the facet group's values. Uses the collection's own English terms, e.g. 'print' or 'drawing' for object types; 'etching' finds nothing.

params.name: relation_bin_id
params.description: Relation bin id from the group's relationGroups or the selectedRelationBinId in list-search-facets. Bins differ per group: the default is 'Everything related to' for ObjectType, while Artist uses b24e

params.name: context
params.description: Collection to search

commands.summary: Get full details of an artwork: title, maker, dating, dimensions, materials, description, location, image id and the full data tab

params.name: object_node_id
params.description: Artwork objectNodeId (32-char hex) from search-collection, or the part after '--' in an /en/collection/object/... URL

params.name: language
params.description: Response language

commands.summary: Get an artwork's or publication's title in each available language (en, nl)

params.name: object_node_id
params.description: objectNodeId of the artwork or library object

params.name: domain
params.description: Art for artworks, Library for publications

commands.summary: Get a collection node page (person/maker, object type, topic, place): its title, type and featured artworks such as most viewed and works through the years

params.name: node_id
params.description: Node/facet id (32-char hex), e.g. painting = 3159edbfc6b22de59dfb2522fecc2706, Rachel Ruysch = 3eaff215275e2ebd47d02cfba2044cc8

params.name: language
params.description: Response language

commands.summary: Resolve a facet/node id to its name and node type (e.g. Person 'Rachel Ruysch')

params.name: facet_id
params.description: Facet/node id (32-char hex)

params.name: language
params.description: Response language

commands.summary: Get details of a Rijksmuseum library publication: title, type, authors and properties, ISBN, and a link to the library catalogue

params.name: object_node_id
params.description: Library objectNodeId from search-library

params.name: language
params.description: Response language
